---
title: "Compare Scenarios"
---

**Purpose:** This page directly compares the population-level outcomes of 2+ scenarios



## Setup

Define the scenarios to compare and build combined data frames from the Oct 1 census.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# ── Define scenarios ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Edit these two named vectors to change which scenarios are compared

scen_files <- c(
  null_cold   = "results/null_cold.rds",
  temp_offset = "results/temp_offset.rds"
)

scen_labels <- c(
  null_cold   = "Null (cold only)",
  temp_offset = "Cold + Warm (offset)"
)

# Colour palette (one colour per scenario)
scen_pal <- setNames(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3, length(scen_files)), "Set1")[rev(seq_along(scen_files))],
  scen_labels
)

# ── Load RDS files ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
scen_list <- map(scen_files, readRDS)

# ── Oct 1 population summary (one row per year × scenario) ──────────────────
oct1_pop <- map2_dfr(scen_list, names(scen_list), \(res, scen) {
  exp_start <- res$params$mindate + years(res$params$nyears_burnin)
  res$ibm_long |>
    filter(month(date) == 10, day(date) == 1) |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarise(n = n(), biomass_kg = sum(weight) / 1000, .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(
      scenario  = scen_labels[[scen]],
      phase     = factor(
        if_else(date < exp_start, "Burn-in", "Experimental"),
        levels = c("Burn-in", "Experimental")
      ),
      year      = year(date),
      exp_start = exp_start
    )
})

# ── Oct 1 individual-level data (one row per fish × year × scenario) ─────────
oct1_ind <- map2_dfr(scen_list, names(scen_list), \(res, scen) {
  exp_start <- res$params$mindate + years(res$params$nyears_burnin)
  res$ibm_long |>
    filter(month(date) == 10, day(date) == 1) |>
    mutate(
      scenario  = scen_labels[[scen]],
      phase     = factor(
        if_else(date < exp_start, "Burn-in", "Experimental"),
        levels = c("Burn-in", "Experimental")
      ),
      year      = year(date),
      age_class = floor(age)
    )
})

# Shared exp_start line for time series (assumes same burn-in length across scenarios)
exp_start_yr <- year(oct1_pop$exp_start[1])
```
:::


---

## Abundance dynamics


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# ── Summary stats (mean, SD, CV) by scenario × phase ───────────────────────
abund_sum <- oct1_pop |>
  group_by(scenario, phase) |>
  summarise(
    mean_n = mean(n),
    sd_n   = sd(n),
    cv_n   = sd(n) / mean(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ── Time series ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_n_ts <- ggplot(oct1_pop, aes(x = year, y = n, color = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = exp_start_yr, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = scen_pal) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Abundance (N)", color = NULL,
       title = "(A) Annual abundance (Oct 1)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position   = c(0.8, 0.88),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.7), color = NA),
    legend.margin     = margin(4, 6, 4, 6)
  )

# ── Mean ± SD bar chart ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_n_mean <- ggplot(abund_sum %>% filter(phase == "Burn-in"), aes(x = scenario, y = mean_n, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_n - sd_n, ymax = mean_n + sd_n),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scen_pal) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean N", fill = NULL,
       title = "(B) Mean burn-in abundance") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── CV bar chart ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_n_cv <- ggplot(abund_sum %>% filter(phase == "Burn-in"), aes(x = scenario, y = cv_n, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scen_pal) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "CV", fill = NULL,
       title = "(C) CV of burn-in abundance") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_n_ts + p_n_mean + p_n_cv +
  plot_layout(widths = c(2.5, 1, 1))
```

## Weight-at-age

Mean weight (± SD) at each integer age class, pooled across all Oct 1 censuses.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
waa <- oct1_ind |>
  filter(phase == "Burn-in") |>
  group_by(scenario, age_class) |>
  summarise(
    mean_wt = mean(weight),
    sd_wt   = sd(weight),
    n       = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  # Keep only age classes represented in both scenarios with ≥5 fish
  group_by(age_class) |>
  filter(n_distinct(scenario) == length(scen_labels), all(n >= 5)) |>
  ungroup()

ggplot(waa, aes(x = age_class, y = mean_wt, color = scenario, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = mean_wt - sd_wt, ymax = mean_wt + sd_wt),
    alpha = 0.15, color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = scen_pal) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scen_pal) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(waa$age_class))) +
  labs(
    x = "Age class (years)", y = "Weight (g)",
    color = NULL, fill = NULL,
    title = "Mean burn-in weight-at-age (Oct 1 census)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Size and age structure

Mean abundance, biomass, and proportional age structure (± SD across burn-in years) at each integer age class on the Oct 1 census.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# ── Per-year counts and biomass by age class (zeros for absent classes) ───────
age_yr <- oct1_ind |>
  filter(phase == "Burn-in") |>
  group_by(scenario, year, age_class) |>
  summarise(n = n(), biomass_kg = sum(weight) / 1000, .groups = "drop") |>
  complete(scenario, year, age_class, fill = list(n = 0, biomass_kg = 0))

# ── Mean abundance by age class ───────────────────────────────────────────────
n_by_age <- age_yr |>
  group_by(scenario, age_class) |>
  summarise(mean_n = mean(n), sd_n = sd(n), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(age_class) |>
  filter(any(mean_n >= 1)) |>
  ungroup()

age_breaks <- sort(unique(n_by_age$age_class))

# ── Proportion of total N by age class, per year ─────────────────────────────
prop_n_by_age <- age_yr |>
  group_by(scenario, year) |>
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(scenario, age_class) |>
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop), sd_prop = sd(prop), .groups = "drop") |>
  semi_join(n_by_age, by = "age_class")

# ── Mean biomass by age class ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
b_by_age <- age_yr |>
  group_by(scenario, age_class) |>
  summarise(mean_b = mean(biomass_kg), sd_b = sd(biomass_kg), .groups = "drop") |>
  semi_join(n_by_age, by = "age_class")

# ── Proportion of total biomass by age class, per year ───────────────────────
prop_b_by_age <- age_yr |>
  group_by(scenario, year) |>
  mutate(prop = biomass_kg / sum(biomass_kg)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(scenario, age_class) |>
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop), sd_prop = sd(prop), .groups = "drop") |>
  semi_join(n_by_age, by = "age_class")

# ── Shared plot helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
age_line_plot <- function(data, y, ymin, ymax, ylab, title, pct = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = age_class, y = {{ y }}, color = scenario, fill = scenario)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(0, {{ ymin }}), ymax = {{ ymax }}), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = scen_pal) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = scen_pal) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = age_breaks) +
    labs(x = "Age class (years)", y = ylab, color = NULL, fill = NULL, title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  if (pct) p <- p + scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1))
  p
}

# ── Four plots ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_age_n <- age_line_plot(n_by_age,    mean_n,    mean_n - sd_n,    mean_n + sd_n,
                         "Mean abundance (N)",      "(A) Mean abundance by age")
p_age_np <- age_line_plot(prop_n_by_age, mean_prop, mean_prop - sd_prop, mean_prop + sd_prop,
                         "Proportion of total N",  "(B) Proportional abundance by age", pct = TRUE)
p_age_b  <- age_line_plot(b_by_age,   mean_b,    mean_b - sd_b,    mean_b + sd_b,
                         "Mean biomass (kg)",       "(C) Mean biomass by age")
p_age_bp <- age_line_plot(prop_b_by_age, mean_prop, mean_prop - sd_prop, mean_prop + sd_prop,
                         "Proportion of total biomass", "(D) Proportional biomass by age",
                         pct = TRUE, show_legend = TRUE)

(p_age_n + p_age_np) / (p_age_b + p_age_bp)
```

## Proportion age-2+

Mean proportion of the population (by abundance and by biomass) comprising age-2+ fish, 
shown by scenario and phase.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
age2plus <- oct1_ind |>
  filter(phase == "Burn-in") |>
  group_by(scenario, phase, year) |>
  summarise(
    prop_n = mean(age_class >= 2),
    prop_b = sum(weight[age_class >= 2]) / sum(weight),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(scenario, phase) |>
  summarise(
    `By abundance` = mean(prop_n),
    `By biomass`   = mean(prop_b),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(c(`By abundance`, `By biomass`),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "proportion")

ggplot(age2plus, aes(x = scenario, y = proportion, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~phase) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Proportion age-2+", fill = NULL,
    title = "Proportion of population age-2+ (Oct 1, burn-in only)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "right",
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1)
  )
```
